Rohit Ande Gmail ID - rohitande9604@gmail.com Mobile No - 9767850065 | Pune, India

Investment Banking Operations · Corporate Actions · Reconciliation · Trade Settlements · Bloomberg · IDC

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Investment Banking Operations professional with 5+ years of experience across corporate actions, cash & stock reconciliation, derivatives trade settlement & NAV Calculation. Proven track record supporting Tier-1 institutional clients including BlackRock, PIMCO, and State Street while ensuring SLA adherence, regulatory compliance, and risk mitigation. Experienced in operational transitions, quality control (QC), trade lifecycle management and process improvement within high-volume financial services environments.

CORE COMPETENCIES

• • • NAV & Market Value Impact Analysis Issue Investigation & Research • Break Investigation & Resolution • Pricing Validation (Bloomberg, IDC & DTC) • Corporate Actions NAV Impact • SLA & Cut-off Management • Team Training & SME Support • SOP Documentation & Process Migration • SLA Monitoring & Critical Cut-Off Management •

Corporate Actions Processing (Mandatory & Voluntary) Cash & Stock Reconciliation / Break Resolution Bloomberg Terminal, DTCC & IDC Pricing Validation

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Transcom — Clearing and Settlement Associate

Mar 2026 – Present

Strong understanding of Trade Life Cycle, Clearing, and Settlement processes. • Monitor and process equity, fixed income, and corporate action-related settlements. Ensure timely settlement of trades through Euroclear and Clearstream platforms. • Investigate and resolve settlement fails, unmatched trades, and cash or stock breaks. • Reconcile cash and positions on a daily basis. • Process free-of-payment (FOP) and delivery-versus-payment (DVP) instructions. • • Good analytical and problem-solving skills. • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.

State Street Associate 2 — Asset Servicing - NAM - Corporate Actions & Reconciliation

Aug 2022 – Feb 2026 Processed 100+ mandatory and voluntary corporate actions monthly — mergers, stock splits, tender offers, buybacks, and dividends — across US & EMEA markets with 99.7% accuracy while meeting T+1/T+2 settlement deadlines in NAM Shift Support. Executed cash and stock position reconciliations, Trade Lifecycle management, identifying and resolving custody and accounting breaks between internal books and custodian records per T+1/T+2 settlement standards. Performed payment execution for cross-border settlements and corporate action proceeds; validated event pricing using Bloomberg, IDC. Delivered NAV and market value impact analysis for institutional fund clients, ensuring accurate and timely portfolio valuations in compliance with fund accounting standards. Ensured all reconciliation breaks in Cash & Stock are validated and justified for each calculated NAV.





•

• Oversee end-to-end fund operational workflows including cash & stock reconciliation, derivatives settlement, and NAV-impact validation. • • • Documented errors identified during review stage and resolved recurring issues through training and root cause analysis. • Managed the end-to-end trade lifecycle for Equity, Fixed Income, and Derivatives transactions, covering trade capture, trade enrichment, Ensure NAV-related deliverables meet defined SLAs with zero financial impact to the organization. Performed end-to-end NAV calculation and review for institutional funds across US & CAD markets.



settlement, reconciliation, and exception management while ensuring adherence to market cut-offs and SLAs. Performed trade capture and trade enrichment by validating trade details, settlement instructions (SSI), counterparty information, security master data, and pricing attributes to ensure accurate downstream processing.

• Utilized SmartStream TLM (Transaction Lifecycle Management) to perform cash and stock reconciliations, investigate reconciliation breaks, conduct

root cause analysis, and resolve exceptions to support seamless trade processing.

• Monitored and resolved trade processing and settlement exceptions, collaborating with custodians, brokers, and global operations teams to

•

minimize settlement fails and improve straight-through processing (STP) efficiency. Supported institutional fund operations through trade processing, NAV impact validation, corporate actions, reconciliation, and settlement controls, ensuring operational accuracy, regulatory compliance, and timely client deliverables.



SBG Traders — Accountant

Feb 2020 – Jul 2022

Managed Accounts Receivable and customer billing. • • • •

Processed invoices, multiple bank receipts, and payment updates. Performed bank reconciliation and debtor reconciliation. Prepared monthly financial summaries and maintained daily transaction records. Addressed customer queries and ensured timely issue resolution.

TECHNICAL SKILLS & TOOLS

Financial Systems

Bloomberg Terminal, IDC, MCH (Multi Currency Horizon) Accounting System, MS Office – Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot, Macros)

EDUCATION

Master of Business Administration (MBA) – IMSCD&R, Ahmednagar (2015–2017) • Bachelor of Commerce (B. Com) – Ahmednagar, College (2012–2015)

LANGUAGES



English, Hindi, Marathi, Telugu.

sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Transcom — Clearing and Settlement Associate
Mar 2026 – Present
Strong understanding of Trade Life Cycle, Clearing, and Settlement processes. • Monitor and process equity, fixed income, and corporate action-related settlements. Ensure timely settlement of trades through Euroclear and Clearstream platforms. • Investigate and resolve settlement fails, unmatched trades, and cash or stock breaks. • Reconcile cash and positions on a daily basis. • Process free-of-payment (FOP) and delivery-versus-payment (DVP) instructions. • • Good analytical and problem-solving skills. • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
State Street Associate 2 — Asset Servicing - NAM - Corporate Actions & Reconciliation
Aug 2022 – Feb 2026 Processed 100+ mandatory and voluntary corporate actions monthly — mergers, stock splits, tender offers, buybacks, and dividends — across US & EMEA markets with 99.7% accuracy while meeting T+1/T+2 settlement deadlines in NAM Shift Support. Executed cash and stock position reconciliations, Trade Lifecycle management, identifying and resolving custody and accounting breaks between internal books and custodian records per T+1/T+2 settlement standards. Performed payment execution for cross-border settlements and corporate action proceeds; validated event pricing using Bloomberg, IDC. Delivered NAV and market value impact analysis for institutional fund clients, ensuring accurate and timely portfolio valuations in compliance with fund accounting standards. Ensured all reconciliation breaks in Cash & Stock are validated and justified for each calculated NAV.


•
• Oversee end-to-end fund operational workflows including cash & stock reconciliation, derivatives settlement, and NAV-impact validation. • • • Documented errors identified during review stage and resolved recurring issues through training and root cause analysis. • Managed the end-to-end trade lifecycle for Equity, Fixed Income, and Derivatives transactions, covering trade capture, trade enrichment, Ensure NAV-related deliverables meet defined SLAs with zero financial impact to the organization. Performed end-to-end NAV calculation and review for institutional funds across US & CAD markets.

settlement, reconciliation, and exception management while ensuring adherence to market cut-offs and SLAs. Performed trade capture and trade enrichment by validating trade details, settlement instructions (SSI), counterparty information, security master data, and pricing attributes to ensure accurate downstream processing.
• Utilized SmartStream TLM (Transaction Lifecycle Management) to perform cash and stock reconciliations, investigate reconciliation breaks, conduct
root cause analysis, and resolve exceptions to support seamless trade processing.
• Monitored and resolved trade processing and settlement exceptions, collaborating with custodians, brokers, and global operations teams to
•
minimize settlement fails and improve straight-through processing (STP) efficiency. Supported institutional fund operations through trade processing, NAV impact validation, corporate actions, reconciliation, and settlement controls, ensuring operational accuracy, regulatory compliance, and timely client deliverables.

SBG Traders — Accountant
Feb 2020 – Jul 2022
Managed Accounts Receivable and customer billing. • • • •
Processed invoices, multiple bank receipts, and payment updates. Performed bank reconciliation and debtor reconciliation. Prepared monthly financial summaries and maintained daily transaction records. Addressed customer queries and ensured timely issue resolution.
